scripts.ios:development: node scripts/with-env.js development react-native run-ios --scheme tasksapp-development
scripts.ios:staging: node scripts/with-env.js staging react-native run-ios --scheme tasksapp-staging
scripts.ios:production: node scripts/with-env.js production react-native run-ios --scheme tasksapp-production
scripts.android:development: node scripts/with-env.js development react-native run-android --mode=developmentDebug --appId com.tasksapp.dev
scripts.android:staging: node scripts/with-env.js staging react-native run-android --mode=stagingDebug --appId com.tasksapp.staging
scripts.android:production: node scripts/with-env.js production react-native run-android --mode=productionDebug --appId com.tasksapp
scripts.android:development:release: node scripts/with-env.js development react-native run-android --mode=developmentRelease --appId com.tasksapp.dev
scripts.android:staging:release: node scripts/with-env.js staging react-native run-android --mode=stagingRelease --appId com.tasksapp.staging
scripts.android:production:release: node scripts/with-env.js production react-native run-android --mode=productionRelease --appId com.tasksapp
scripts.env:check: node scripts/with-env.js development node -e "console.log('ENVFILE OK:', process.env.ENVFILE)"
